reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Gecko
reauth_confirm.description: Your Gecko authentication has expired. Please re-authenticate to restore connectivity.

account.title: Connect to your Gecko account
account.description: Account access could not be verified. Select Submit to retry. If authentication failed, sign in to Gecko again.

abort.api_error: Failed to connect to the Gecko API. Please try again later.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same Gecko account as this integration.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to read your Gecko account. Check connectivity and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication is invalid or incomplete. Sign in again to continue.

application_credentials.description: Use OAuth application credentials issued for your Gecko integration. The application must allow Home Assistant's OAuth callback and the Gecko API audience. Contact Gecko for credential access and permissions; a spa account login is not an application credential. Existing custom-integration users may continue using the bundled login.

unsupported_watercare_mode.message: The selected watercare mode is not supported.

watercare_unavailable.message: Watercare control is unavailable. Check the spa connection and try again.

command_failed.message: The command could not be delivered to the spa. Check the connection and try again.

unsupported_preset_mode.message: The selected watercare preset is not supported.

unsupported_hvac_mode.message: This thermostat supports heating mode only.

device_unavailable.message: The spa or this control is unavailable. Check the connection and try again.

device_reconnected.message: The spa reconnected while this command was in progress. Try again.

pump_start_unconfirmed.message: The pump has not confirmed running. It may still start at low speed; check its state before retrying.

pump_automatic_demand.message: The pump is running for an automatic demand, such as filtration or heating, and cannot be stopped manually.

unsupported_pump_speed.message: The selected pump speed is not supported.

light_color_unsupported.message: This light does not report support for color or brightness control.

invalid_temperature.message: The temperature must be a finite number within the limits reported by the spa.
